_doc: Reviewed authorship cases where this dataset's verse authors deliberately differ from the ShabadOS database (4.8.7). crosscheck_authors.py fails a rebuild on any verse disagreement NOT covered here (by id range or Ang range). Adding an entry is a scholarly decision: say why, keep it pending until a scholar signs (gate G3).

flags.note: Headings read ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ੧ (Ang 553). Many read the ੧ as Guru Nanak, addressing Mardana; ShabadOS credits Guru Nanak Dev Ji. Left unchanged for the scholar.

Raagmala's authorship is debated; the M5 label is carried forward from Mundavani's ਮਹਲਾ ੫, and ShabadOS credits Poet Alam. Neither is settled -- left unchanged; the scholar decides whether it needs its own label.
Heading ਗਉੜੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ (Ang 326). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Kabir.
Heading ਭੈਰਉ ਮਹਲਾ ੫, closing ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਖਾਨਾ (Ang 1136). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Kabir.
Heading ਸਾਰੰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਸੂਰਦਾਸ (Ang 1253). The print's ਮਹਲਾ ੫ is kept; ShabadOS credits Surdas.

ShabadOS splits some Swaiyye differently (The Bhatts->Gayand 42 lines, Kalsahar->Jalap 6, Sal->Bhikha 6, Mathura->Haribans 5). bhatt_attribution.json is a prior SME-audited table and is not changed here.
